name: Earthshatter Warhammer

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus : +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Adamantine
effects.tooltip: Adamantine : Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

effects.name: Greater Stone Prison
effects.tooltip: Greater Stone Prison : This weapon is invested with the power of the earth. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will attempt to turn the target to stone, as the Flesh to Stone spell. A successful Fortitude save (DC 33) negates this effect.

effects.name: Rock Shattering
effects.tooltip: Rock Shattering : When striking stone-like creatures (such as gargoyles and earth elementals ) or creatures that have been turned to stone, there is a chance this weapon will instantly shatter and destroy the target.

effects.name: Maiming
effects.tooltip: Maiming : This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 1 to 6, x3 - 2 to 12, x4 - 3 to 18.

effects.name: Unwieldy
effects.tooltip: Unwieldy : This weapon is very large and makes you clumsier as you wield it, causing a -2 Dexterity penalty.

flavor_text: A tremendous blunt weapon infused with the power of Orlassk , the daelkyr Lord of Stone. It can trap enemies in stone, then shatter that stone forcefully with adamantine-reinforced blows.
tips: Monsters slain by the Rock Shattering effect will be credited to Misadventure instead of the player. You can remove the Unwieldy penalty with a Sustaining Symbiont .

source.raw: The Lord of Stone , End chest
